item.title: Color zoning affects the appearance of amethyst
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: The purple color in amethyst may be distributed unevenly, influencing the appearance of the cut gem.
EXIMUTC view: Inspect face-up color zoning rather than judging only by weight.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/amethyst-quality-factor
